description.value: Arthouse Hotel is a boutique hotel on the Upper West Side. The hotel says our century-old building retains many of its historic accents, mixed with modern art and design. It is near the subway on Broadway and a short walk from Central Park and Riverside Park. Arthouse Hotel carries a Tripadvisor score of 4.2 Good (8,181) from traveler reviews.
